svg.title: Every continuation of "t" the specimen considers, from untrained to trained.
svg.desc: Columns are positions 1 to 8. Each string's probability P(x₂…xₖ | "t") = Π P(next | prefix) is the length of its own interval of the vertical axis, nested inside its prefix's interval; edges join each string to its one-character extensions, inked in proportion to probability^0.6 (edges too faint to see are omitted). 38 moments of training (AdamW, η 0.02 → 0.002 (warmup 20, cosine), β₂ 0.95, weight decay 0.01 on matrices, clip 1) are overlaid. Value ink: the final model, which has learned "to be or".
